## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] A changeset (`npm run changeset`), if a published package changes
- [ ] Tests for the change, including keyboard and screen reader behavior for components
- [ ] JSDoc and the docs examples (`apps/website/src/demos.tsx`) updated, if the API changes
- [ ] The **Update screenshots** workflow run, if it's meant to look different
